description: Optimize the cubic Fm-3m bulk structure of aluminum.
user_prompt: Optimize the cubic (Fm-3m) bulk structure of aluminum (Al). Report the final converged energy and lattice constant.

references: Jain, Ong, Hautier, Chen, Richards, Dacek, Cholia, Gunter, Skinner, Ceder & Persson, APL Mater. 1, 011002 (2013)
method.modeling: fcc Al conventional cubic bulk cell with space group Fm-3m; Al formula unit is one atom.
method.rationale: The target energy is the Materials Project mp-134 PBE energy per atom, equal to energy per formula unit for elemental Al. Only the total energy is scored; the lattice constant is left as a diagnostic because the accepted energy is tied to MP PAW/PBE conventions. The +/-0.5 eV/f.u. absolute tolerance covers PAW dataset, cutoff, and smearing differences while still flagging qualitatively wrong bulk calculations.
